summary: Wrote a four-phase implementation plan for the half-line test context note. No research report existed for this round, and the Stage 1.5 assessment found research unnecessary: the cited probe is readable on this filesystem and plan-time reads grounded every declaration name, probe path, and disclaimer the note must carry. One correction surfaced: the dispatch description mis-locates the six-mechanism survival analysis (it is not in the .lean probe), resolved as a citation decision recorded in the plan. The plan validates with zero warnings and harvests five real paths plus the __WHOLE_TREE__ sentinel.
